hand grasping or holding an object
justification: Both surfaces include animal-like creatures, arms with clearly rendered hands holding or grasping something, and banded linear patterning across the body/surface, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a flat, schematic low-relief assemblage of profile quadrupeds, birds and abstract bands stacked in registers on a rectangular pillar, whereas B is a fully three-dimensional, naturalistically proportioned single human figure in dynamic pose with headdress, armlets, sash and a severed-head-like object raised aloft / nothing in A corresponds to that figural scheme.
